name: profile_app_stack
description: Full Python application stack deploying a FastAPI/Gunicorn application from a Git repository onto Ubuntu. Manages Python runtime and virtualenv setup, PostgreSQL database provisioning, application deployment, systemd service unit generation, Alembic database migrations, log rotation, and Prometheus monitoring.

name: profile_haproxy
description: HAProxy 2.x load balancer profile managing installation, templated haproxy.cfg, per-backend config fragments, custom HTTP error pages, UFW firewall rules, and dynamic backend discovery via PuppetDB exported resources.

name: profile_redis_cluster
description: Redis server profile wrapping the puppet-redis Forge module, configuring AOF persistence, RDB snapshots, memory limits, and password authentication with PuppetDB-based cluster node discovery and a custom Facter fact for primary/replica role detection.

name: base_utils
description: Cross-cutting base utilities module included by all roles, providing MOTD management, OS-conditional utility package installation, a config_entry defined type, custom types and functions, a custom Facter fact, and Bolt tasks/plans for operational automation.

name: profile_base_base
description: Thin site profile wrapper included by every role that composes base_utils with NTP (chrony) and syslog (rsyslog) management, acting as the universal baseline applied before any workload-specific profile.

name: puppetdb_query_stub
description: Test/development stub providing a no-op implementation of the puppetdb_query() function, used during local Vagrant testing and CI to prevent catalog compilation failures when a live PuppetDB server is unavailable.
